content.comment_body: Is it possible to connect [product_name] modules with a cable? There isn't enough space to mount all modules on a single DIN rail.

There is no official connection cable from [company_name]. An alternative is to install a second basic module on another DIN rail and attach the extension modules to it. The two base modules can then communicate via Ethernet.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are asking about separating [product_name] modules across two DIN rails and whether a cable solution is offered. Responses clarify that [company_name] does not provide an official cable for this purpose and suggest using multiple base modules with Ethernet communication as a workaround, highlighting the lack of direct support for this type of modular expansion.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects to easily connect [product_name] modules across multiple DIN rails using a simple cable, enabling physical separation without impacting functionality.
